Authentication.notes: Only the built-in password provider exists; the admin dashboard lists providers, so these two answer 404.

Device.notes: Devices are stored (internal/storage/device.go) and appear in sessions, but there are no device-management routes, so the dashboard's Devices page 404s.

Library.notes: Library notification hooks and file/download endpoints are not implemented.

MusicGenre.notes: Music libraries are not scanned (video-first scope, docs/01).

Artist.notes: Music libraries are not scanned (video-first scope, docs/01); not on ROADMAP.md.

Trailer.notes: Deprecated in the reference and served by a plugin there; local trailers are served by /Items/{id}/LocalTrailers.

LibraryStructure.notes: Adding, removing and updating the paths of an existing library is not implemented; a library's paths are set when it is created.

ItemLookup.notes: Remote search/identify needs a search API on the metadata provider interface (docs/08); TMDB is used only during scans.

ItemUpdate.notes: Metadata editing is left to an external cataloging tool (README, 'Not a media organizer').

ScheduledTask.notes: Only the library-scan task and its start route exist.

RemoteImage.notes: Not implemented; the dashboard's image editor 404s on /RemoteImages/Providers (docs/11).

MediaInfo.notes: Out of scope for v1 (docs/01, decision D8). Live streams belong to tuners.

Video.notes: Version merging/splitting is not offered; versions are grouped by file naming at scan time.

Audio.notes: Music is not cataloged or streamed (video-first scope, docs/01).

TrickPlay.notes: Tinyfin generates and serves trickplay sheets (playback.trickplay); only operations that are not registered are classified by this default.

Subtitle.notes: External subtitle files are cataloged and served; see the per-route overlay for the parts that are not (subtitle providers).

Lyric.notes: Music is not cataloged (video-first scope, docs/01).

Session.notes: Remote control of other sessions is not implemented (the /socket transport exists).

UserData.notes: Star ratings are not implemented (likes are, through UserData).

SyncPlay.notes: Not in scope for v1; the web client treats 404 on /SyncPlay/List as 'unavailable'.

LiveTv.notes: Out of scope for v1 (docs/01, decision D8).

Channel.notes: Out of scope for v1 (docs/01, decision D8). Channels are a plugin concept in the reference.

Localization.notes: Not implemented; clients fall back to built-in lists.

Backup.notes: State is one SQLite file (docs/05), so a backup is a file copy; the reference's archive format is specific to it.

GET /Items/Filters2.notes: Genres and tags are listed; AudioLanguages only when item types are named and as codes; SubtitleLanguages is always empty.
GET /Items/Filters2.reference: Lists the genres, tags, and the audio and subtitle languages present.

GET /LiveTv/Programs.notes: Always returns an empty result so the series detail page does not break; no Live TV exists.

GET /web/ConfigurationPages.notes: Always []: there is no plugin system.

GET /Sessions.notes: In-process registry fed by authentication and playback reports; admin only.

GET /System/Configuration/{key}.notes: Only the network key is served (GET /System/Configuration/network).

POST /System/Configuration/{key}.notes: Only the network key is served (POST /System/Configuration/network).

GET /Videos/{itemId}/stream.notes: Served by the wildcard file route.

GET /Videos/{itemId}/stream.{container}.notes: Served by the wildcard file route.

HEAD /Videos/{itemId}/stream.notes: Served by the wildcard file route.

HEAD /Videos/{itemId}/stream.{container}.notes: Served by the wildcard file route.

GET /Items/{itemId}/File.notes: Raw file delivery is not implemented.

POST /Sessions/Capabilities.notes: The Full variant is served; the plain one is the older form of the same report.

POST /System/Restart.notes: Not implemented; a supervisor restarts the process.

POST /Users/AuthenticateWithQuickConnect.notes: A secret is single use and a disabled account is refused (the reference replays secrets and logs disabled accounts in). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

GET /Users/{userId}.notes: HasPassword reflects whether a password is set (the reference reports true for everyone). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

DELETE /Users/{userId}.notes: A refused deletion of the last administrator revokes nothing (the reference logs them out first). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

POST /Users/ForgotPassword.notes: PinFile carries the bare file name, not the absolute server path. Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

POST /Users/ForgotPassword/Pin.notes: Redeem attempts are rate limited (the reference does not throttle). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

POST /Users.notes: An explicit null Configuration resets preferences (the reference answers 500). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

POST /Startup/User.notes: No default administrator is created when the wizard's user page opens (the reference creates an empty-password root). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

POST /Collections.notes: Input is validated before anything is created and bad input is 400 (the reference creates an empty collection and answers 500). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

GET /Items.notes: The library-access restriction also applies when items are requested by Ids (the reference skips it). Recorded as a divergence in the contract scenarios.

GET /Videos/{routeItemId}/{routeMediaSou.notes: Served for authenticated callers only: the reference serves it to anonymous ones (subtitles.stream.R9). Formats srt, vtt, ass, ssa, json and ttml from external SubRip/WebVTT/ASS/SSA/SAMI files and embedded text tracks (extracted with ffmpeg); bitmap tracks are not converted.
As the route without the start position; authenticated callers only (subtitles.stream.R9).

GET /Videos/{itemId}/{mediaSourceId}/Sub.notes: Served by the wildcard subtitle route (subtitles.playlist.R1).

GET /Items/{itemId}/RemoteSearch/Subtitl.notes: Answers like a server with no subtitle provider: an empty list. Searching and downloading from remote subtitle providers is not planned (it needs provider plugins and network access).

POST /Items/{itemId}/RemoteSearch/Subtit.notes: Accepted and ignored: there is no provider to download from. Searching and downloading from remote subtitle providers is not planned (it needs provider plugins and network access).

GET /Providers/Subtitles/Subtitles/{subt.notes: Answers 500 like the reference does for an id no provider issued. Searching and downloading from remote subtitle providers is not planned (it needs provider plugins and network access).

GET /ScheduledTasks.notes: Lists only the tasks Tinyfin really runs (RefreshLibrary, RefreshTrickplayImages, CleanActivityLog) with the reference's Ids and Keys; the reference's ~20 tasks (plugin updates, subtitle/lyric downloads, ...) belong to subsystems that do not exist. See specs/admin.md.

DELETE /ScheduledTasks/Running/{taskId}.notes: Cancels a running library scan or trickplay batch; stopping a task that is not running is a 204 no-op (the reference answers 500).

POST /Backup/Create.notes: Snapshots the SQLite database only (zip with manifest.json + database/tinyfin.db); Metadata/Trickplay/Subtitles options are echoed but ignored. Unlike the reference it also works during a library scan.

POST /Backup/Restore.notes: Validates the request (400/404) and answers 501: restoring over a running server's database is not planned; copy database/tinyfin.db over the database file with the server stopped.

GET /System/Logs.notes: Lists the daily log_YYYYMMDD.log files cmd/tinyfin tees its output to; the log format is the Go standard logger's, with no retention.

GET /Plugins.notes: No plugin system (D8, D11): always an empty list, where the reference lists its bundled providers and a default repository.

GET /Packages.notes: No plugin system (D8, D11): always an empty list, where the reference lists its bundled providers and a default repository.

GET /Repositories.notes: No plugin system (D8, D11): always an empty list, where the reference lists its bundled providers and a default repository.
